movie_details.title: Race Gurram
movie_details.overview: Two brothers with opposite personalities: honest cop Ram (Shaam) and carefree, intelligent rebel Lucky (Allu Arjun). When a corrupt politician, Siva Reddy (Ravi Kishan), threatens Ram’s career and family, Lucky intervenes, leading to a high-stakes battle of wits and action.
